newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-STUTTGART FALTER TO LEAVE BAYERN TOP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-STUTTGART FALTER TO LEAVE BAYERN TOP.

text.p: VfB Stuttgart failed to recapture the top spot in the Bundesliga on Sunday, losing 3-1 away to strugglers Duisburg.
Stuttgart began the weekend as league leaders but Bayern Munich jumped from third to first place on Saturday with a 2-1 win over bottom club Hansa Rostock.
Brazilian striker Giovane Elber gave Stuttgart a dream start after just 38 seconds, pouncing on a rebound from a Fredi Bobic shot to score his 10th league goal of the season.

But Duisburg fought back and were back on level terms in the seventh minute with a goal from Markus Osthoff. Thomas Vana put Duisburg ahead after the break when his long-range shot was deflected past Stuttgart goalkeeper Franz Wohlfahrt.
Michael Zeyer sealed the points for Duisburg in the 78th minute.
Stuttgart's defeat left them in second place, level on points with Borussia Dortmund and Bayer Leverkusen. They have another chance to leapfrog over Bayern when the two sides clash next Sunday.
